purpose: Prospective governance for future wave selection so later waves expand evidence and opportunity coverage systematically rather than acting as post-failure rescue.

prospective_selection_law.own_outcome_blindness: Every future candidate identity and its material semantics must be frozen before its own economic outcome is opened.
prospective_selection_law.no_post_failure_rescue: Future-wave inclusion must be justified by the frozen coverage objective and structural evidence, never because an earlier candidate failed economically.
prospective_selection_law.no_micro_grid_rescue: No post-outcome threshold/lookback/hold micro-grid rescue under an existing identity.
prospective_selection_law.materially_distinct_products: Extended-hours, perpetual, forward/futures-style and standard cash/spot broker products are distinct candidate identities and never aliases substituted into an already frozen candidate.

opportunity_coverage_targets.principle: Seek broad time coverage only where prospectively specified mechanisms can plausibly carry positive economic edge; trading-hour coverage is context, not alpha.

hard21.system_requirement: >=21 ACTUALLY EXECUTED ENTRIES IN EVERY CERTIFIED UTC ISO WEEK
hard21.use_in_future_wave_design: Prefer complementary natural opportunity/session coverage among independently positive-edge mechanisms after primitive edge is established.
